camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi RefundInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ImmediatelyRelease 1 --ProductCode ecs --InstanceId 'i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000' --ProductType '空字符串' --ClientToken '793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494'
description_en: Unsubscribes from an instance that is no longer needed
description_zh: 调用本接口退订不再需要的实例
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi refund-instance --client-token 793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494 --immediately-release 1 --product-code ecs --instance-id i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000 --product-type '空字符串' --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefundInstance

parameters.help_en: Required for idempotent scenarios. A UUID-generated string. This field is used for idempotence. If the same value is passed in multiple calls, the result of the first call is returned. If a result is returned after the call, you can parse the refund order ID, which indicates that the call is successful
parameters.help_zh: 需要幂等场景必填。UUID生成的字符串。此字段用于幂等，多次调用传入同样的值，会返回第一次的结果。调用后如果返回了结果，可以解析到退款订单编号，代表调用成功
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Required for unsubscription scenarios. Valid values: 1: immediately releases the instance. 0: stops the instance first based on the shutdown policy. Only some products support this value. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填。1：标识立即释放。0：标识先停机，根据停机策略停机。仅部分商品支持。默认都是立即释放
parameters.name: immediately_release

parameters.help_en: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product code. If the error code returned after the call indicates that the product is not supported, submit a ticket to request that the cloud service enable this feature
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，产品code。如果调用后错误码提示产品不支持，可提交工单申请云产品允许开通此功能
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The instance ID, not the custom name
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，实例id，非自定义名称
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product type. Unless otherwise specified, pass an empty string. In the debugging tool, you do not need to manually enter a value. Hover over the input box, and a button labeled "Enter empty string" appears. Click this button. When initiating an unsubscription through code, pass an empty string ""
parameters.help_zh: 退订场景必填，产品类型，无特殊说明传入空字符串。在调试工具上，无需手动输入，鼠标放到输入框上，会弹出"输入空字符串"的按钮，点击此按钮即可。通过代码发起退订时，传入英文字符下的空字符串 ""
parameters.name: product_type

HostId.description_en: The site where the execution host resides

OrderId.description_en: The refund order ID returned when the unsubscription is successful
OrderId.description_zh: 退订成功的情况下，返回退款订单id

Message.description_en: The description of the execution result

RequestId.description_en: The Tracing Analysis character string for the execute. Provide this string to the platform when troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 执行链路追踪字符串，排查问题时，可以提供给平台

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates that the call is complete. A value of false indicates that an error occurred
Success.description_zh: success=true代表调用执行完成。success=false代表执行出现错误
